description: Plan a series-named export folder inside an approved Shorts root and remind the caller to create it when missing. Local-only; never writes files or changes Premiere.

brand.description: Channel brand kit. cafe must not reuse watch_club fonts, name cards, or speaker colors.

export_root.description: Absolute Shorts export root, for example the ALL Shorts or Cafe Exports folder.

extension.description: File extension without a dot; defaults to mp4.

series_name.description: Anime or series folder name to create under export_root when missing.

title.description: Short title used as the file stem.

name: plan_short_export_folder

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Plan Short Export Folder
